title.en: Wingtip vortices: where lift leaves a visible trace
title.zh: 翼尖涡：升力留下的可见轨迹

summary.en: An engineering note on pressure difference, induced flow, wake structure and the operational significance of wingtip vortices.
summary.zh: 从压力差、诱导流、尾流结构与运行影响出发理解翼尖涡。

body.en: A wing produces lift through a pressure difference between its upper and lower surfaces. Near the tip, air moves around the wing edge and rolls into a rotating wake.
body.zh: 机翼通过上下表面的压力差产生升力。接近翼尖时，气流绕过翼缘并卷入旋转尾流。

body.en: The resulting vortex connects aerodynamic theory with practical topics including induced drag, separation spacing and formation flight.
body.zh: 翼尖涡将气动理论与诱导阻力、航空器间隔及编队飞行等实践问题连接起来。

title.en: The 2010 Formula One championship: four drivers, one final race
title.zh: 2010 年 F1 冠军争夺：四位车手与最后一站

summary.en: A retrospective analysis of a championship shaped by performance, reliability, strategy and pressure.
summary.zh: 回顾一场由性能、可靠性、策略与压力共同塑造的世界冠军争夺。

body.en: The 2010 season reached its final round with four drivers still in contention. The result depended on more than outright speed: reliability, pit strategy and traffic management all shaped the outcome.
body.zh: 2010 赛季进入收官战时仍有四位车手保留争冠可能。最终结果不仅取决于速度，也受到可靠性、进站策略与交通管理影响。

body.en: The season remains a useful case study in complex competition, where local decisions accumulate into a system-level result.
body.zh: 这一赛季提供了复杂竞争的典型案例：局部决策不断累积，最终形成系统层面的结果。

title.en: Tu-334: an aircraft shaped by a changing industrial system
title.zh: 图-334：产业体系变化中的一型客机

summary.en: A historical article examining how aircraft design, industrial capability and programme timing influenced the Tu-334.
summary.zh: 从飞机设计、产业能力与项目时机审视图-334 的发展历程。

body.en: Aircraft programmes develop inside industrial systems. Supply chains, certification, market timing and institutional continuity can be as decisive as aerodynamic design.
body.zh: 飞机项目始终处于产业体系之中。供应链、适航、市场时机与组织连续性可能与气动设计同样关键。

body.en: The Tu-334 story illustrates the distance between a technically coherent design and a sustainable commercial programme.
body.zh: 图-334 的历程呈现了技术方案与可持续商业项目之间的距离。

title.en: SL-01H: defining a first complete engineering concept
title.zh: SL-01H：建立首个完整工程概念

summary.en: A project note on turning an early racing-car idea into a coordinated design, manufacturing and presentation package.
summary.zh: 记录早期赛车构想如何发展为设计、制造与展示协同的完整方案。

body.en: The first complete project required decisions across geometry, materials, manufacturing sequence and visual presentation.
body.zh: 首个完整项目需要同时处理几何、材料、制造顺序与视觉展示。

body.en: The value of SL-01H lies in the workflow it established: define, model, manufacture, test, communicate and revise.
body.zh: SL-01H 的价值在于建立了定义、建模、制造、测试、沟通与修订的工作流程。

title.en: SL-22H design release: integrating product and team language
title.zh: SL-22H 设计发布：连接产品与团队语言

summary.en: A design-release note covering vehicle form, visual identity, manufacturing and public presentation.
summary.zh: 围绕赛车形态、视觉识别、制造与公开展示展开的设计发布记录。

body.en: A mature engineering delivery needs consistency between the physical product and the way it is explained.
body.zh: 成熟的工程交付需要实体产品与对外表达保持一致。

body.en: SL-22H brought vehicle geometry, team graphics and presentation material into a shared design direction.
body.zh: SL-22H 将赛车几何、团队图形与展示材料纳入统一设计方向。

title.en: Mobility, memory and the design of everyday safety
title.zh: 移动记忆与日常安全设计

summary.en: A reflective essay connecting personal mobility experience with attention to lighting, visibility and road safety.
summary.zh: 从个人移动体验出发，讨论照明、可见性与道路安全设计。

body.en: Everyday transport systems are experienced through small details: a dark corner, a missed rear-side vehicle, a poorly timed warning or an uncertain line of sight.
body.zh: 日常交通系统常通过细节被感知：暗处转弯、后侧来车、提示时机与不稳定视野。

body.en: These observations became early inputs to Litellight, BBLIS and later vehicle-safety studies.
body.zh: 这些观察逐步成为 Litellight、BBLIS 与后续车辆安全研究的早期输入。

title.en: Human state as a system input
title.zh: 将人员状态纳入系统输入

summary.en: A technical note on why attention, fatigue and operating context belong inside intelligent-system design.
summary.zh: 讨论注意力、疲劳与操作情境为何应进入智能系统设计。

body.en: Automation still operates through a relationship with people. Attention, fatigue and workload influence the safety and timing of system intervention.
body.zh: 自动化始终与人形成关系。注意力、疲劳与工作负荷会影响系统干预的安全性与时机。

body.en: Human-state monitoring provides an additional input for adaptive interfaces, warnings and shared-control strategies.
body.zh: 人员状态监测可为自适应界面、警示与共享控制策略提供额外输入。

title.en: From autonomous flight to autonomous missions
title.zh: 从自主飞行走向自主任务

summary.en: An engineering note on the shift from stabilising an aircraft to coordinating a complete mission system.
summary.zh: 讨论研发重点如何从飞行稳定扩展到完整任务系统协同。

body.en: A flight controller keeps an aircraft stable. A mission system must also interpret objectives, constraints, environment, resources and operator intent.
body.zh: 飞控负责保持航空器稳定，任务系统还需要理解目标、约束、环境、资源与操作者意图。

body.en: This shift changes the architecture: planning, perception, communications and human supervision become first-class system elements.
body.zh: 这一变化推动架构扩展，规划、感知、通信与人在回路监督成为核心系统要素。
